description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Two forms. Called with no id: returns a list of what the team has for Joe, as ids only: each reply to one of his messages and each numbered question waiting for him, with its date. No text. Called with one id from that list: returns that one item: for a reply, Joe's message and the team's reply; for a question, its number, why it matters and its choices. One item per call on purpose: if your own safety check refuses one item, the others are still readable. Pass seen on every call: the ids you have already shown Joe. Every id you send is recorded, and the ones you send are left out of waiting, so the list you get back is what Joe has NOT seen. The team uses the record to learn that a reply reached him, and rewrites one that did not: an id you leave out will be rewritten and sent again. Read-only apart from that record. A reply or a new question can take up to an hour to appear.

id.description: One id from the list. Leave it out to get the list.

seen.description: Ids you have already shown Joe in chat. Send your whole list on every call: all of it is recorded, and seen_recorded in the answer says how many (it will equal what you sent, less any duplicate or malformed id).

name: replies_for_joe

already_shown.description: How many items were left out of waiting because you had already shown them.

item.description: With an id: that one reply or question.

seen_recorded.description: How many of the ids you sent were recorded as shown to Joe.

seen_unusable.description: Ids in seen that were not a usable id and were dropped.

waiting.description: With no id: everything the team has for Joe that you have not already shown him, oldest first.

title: The team's replies to Joe
